description:
## Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add
Labels deletion preview and transactional delete; validated DeleteLabelDefinition Action and Ingestion Events. Count selected document/chunk assignments; require matching definition version and confirmed usage counts. Remove all assignments and target settings with definition, preserve resources.
## Tests to add before implementation
Unused and assigned deletion, exclusions cleanup, document/chunk preservation, staff denial, stale version, changed usage rejection, malformed requests and validated Event path.
## Branches/paths validated
Existing assignment mutations lock label rows; deletion takes same label lock, checks usage, and deletes assignments plus definition atomically. Usage preview is manager-only. Counts are informational scope of whole-label deletion, never permission bypass.
## Mocking plan
Real Repo sandbox and Jido execution; no persistence mocks.
## Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content
Ingestion guide: preview/delete Events, destructive semantics and confirmation preconditions.
## Action reuse assessment
Existing SaveLabelDefinition and EditResourceLabels cover update/assignment changes but not deleting a definition with all assignments. New focused DeleteLabelDefinition Action delegates to Labels; existing Access.manager, version lock and schemas reused. No agent tool exposure. UI consumer follows as dependent task.
title: Add authorized label deletion with usage confirmation
